تمتنعوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَنِعُوا (tamtaniʕū) /tam.ta.ni.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# تُمْتَنَعُوا (tumtanaʕū) /tum.ta.na.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
